answer: A bond alone proves nothing, so key it to a hardware root and publish every failure. When an attestation fails, the bond and the machine ID go on a public list peers read before working with that host. Concrete case: a rack of rented VMs sharing one TPM reports one root and gets one bond, so the fortieth clone adds no weight. Quorum must span unrelated subnetworks, and a vine of clones on a single ledge never reaches the crystal.
